title: HelperFSWriteAbortResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's write-abort op: what became of the session. `aborted` means the temporary is gone and the target was never touched — including for an id this daemon never held, because there is then no temporary of ours, which is the state the caller asked for. `committed` means the session had already installed its file; the abort of a finished session is a fact the caller wanted, not an error, and the target is not touched.

outcome.description: Which of the two outcomes the session had when the abort reached it.
